Procreate Brushes Christmas hat & Christmas tree. There are 72 individual stamps included in this procreate brush. These stamp brushes are great for creating digital and printable projects which are graphic design, stationery & printable, doodles, Instagram posts, blog posts, wall art, surface patterns, packaging, posters, business cards, illustrations, blog buttons, etc.

YOU WILL RECEIVE:
– 1 Zip of 3 files, which are:
1) 1 brush set file with 72 stamps created in Procreate. There are 49 leaf doodles brushes, 15 flower doodles brushes and 8 wreath doodles brushes.
2) Bonus: Color Palette of Natural Leaf for 30 color swatches.
3) Bonus: Color Palette of Sakura Blossom for 30 color swatches

HOW TO USE:
– Download the brush set file and import it to your brushes in Procreate
(Use with Procreate only!).
– After install, choose a stamp and tap on your screen for your design.
– You can scale / resize these stamp brushes, change opacity, color or set-ups.

HOW TO INSTALL?
– Open IPAD
– Unzip file
– Download brush set file and it will automatically import into procreate brush collection.

IF NOT, DO THIS TUTORIAL:
1. Download brush set file to folder on your iPad
2. Open the folder and find downloaded brush set file
3. Tap and hold with your finger or apple pencil
4. Choose “Share” from the menu
5. If the option “Open in Procreate” is missing, click on “More”
6. Scroll and find the option “Open in Procreate” and click on it
7. Open your project in Procreate and click on brush icon at the top right corner
8. Find the new brush set in your Brush library

IMPORTANT:
– Use these brushes with Procreate App on IPAD only
– These brushes DO NOT work in Photoshop or any other application.
– This is a digital product. No physical product will be sent to you.
